subject: Warm intro: Fjord Analytics x Redwood — AWS co-sell MAP & demo cadence
messages:
From: Brian Todd <brian.todd@amazon.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Fjord Analytics - Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Hi Dylan / Kimberly,

Quick intro — meet Sara Liu from Fjord Analytics (cc'd). Fjord has built an embedded analytics layer that a number of AWS customers are evaluating; they expressed interest in listing on AWS Marketplace and exploring a co-sell partnership.

Would Redwood be open to a warm intro and a short mutual action plan to map stakeholders and milestones? High level asks from AWS: confirm joint-engagement owner, an initial demo with technical and procurement stakeholders, and a 6–8 week procurement runway if possible.

Sara / Fjord — can you share primary stakeholders and a rough timeline? Dylan / Kimberly — can you propose 2–3 times for a 45-minute sync this week or next?

Thanks,
Brian

--
Brian Todd
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
To: Brian Todd <brian.todd@amazon.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@fjordanalytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Fjord Analytics - Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Brian — really appreciate the intro. Hi Sara, great to meet you by email.

We'd love to get a short joint account planning call scheduled. Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Sep 21, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed Sep 22, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Thu Sep 23, 9:30–10:15am PT

Agenda suggestion: 1) intros & roles, 2) demo scope & audience, 3) procurement timeline + MAP owner, 4) next steps and follow-ups.

Sara — can you share a short stakeholder list (names + roles + procurement lead) and any compliance docs we should pre-review? I attached a brief 1-pager to give Fjord folks context on Redwood's Marketplace and co-sell readiness.

Dylan
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Fjord_IntroDeck.pdf (1-page context)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@fjordanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: Intro: Fjord Analytics - Redwood Inference (AWS co-sell)

Hi Dylan & team — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We can do Wed Sep 22, 2:00pm PT (that works for our exec and procurement leads). Attendees from Fjord:
- Sara Liu (CEO)
- Miguel Ortega (Head of Product)
- Priya Kumar (Director, Procurement)

Procurement runway: target PO within 6 weeks after a successful security/price review. Compliance: we can send a signed NDA right away and have a SOC 2 type II report available (on request). I've attached the signed NDA and a very small intro deck with current integrations.

One ask from our side: would Redwood be willing to include a brief 'redwood marketplace play' section in the MAP that notes recommended field motion and a joint demo script for AWS account teams? That would help internal alignment.

Best,
Sara
Sara Liu
CEO, Fjord Analytics

Great — confirmed for Wed Sep 22 at 2:00pm PT. Calendar invite sent (link below).

I've attached an initial Draft_MAP_v0.2 with a short "redwood marketplace play" section — feel free to annotate before or during the call. Karthik, could you bring a technical slide on integration surface area (APIs, data residency, expected latency) and recommended demo script? Kimberly — can you confirm the commercial contact who will own PO and billing details?

Proposed call agenda (45 min):
- 5 min intros & roles
- 10 min Fjord product demo (Miguel)
- 10 min Redwood marketplace play & integration notes (Dylan / Karthik)
- 10 min procurement runway / pricing expectations (Kimberly)
- 10 min next steps: MAP owner, dates for security artifact exchange, DocuSign / PO cadence

Thanks all — looking forward to the conversation.

Dylan
